items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: So I recorded with Louie and Louie got the job at the Dream... Lee Plutcher and he's coming to Chicago to record... So I recorded with Louie

ctx.x: Did you join Oliver right away? Did you join Kid Oliver when you went to Chicago again?

No, I worked with Louie. Louie left for, Louie wrote my letter too, told me he's coming down, Lee Plutcher and he's coming to Chicago to record. He heard I was going to be in Chicago. He would like to have him record with him at the Hot Five, you know. So I recorded with Louie and Louie got the job at the Dream. So we were drawing so well and Louie asked for more money, you know. And the guy in bottom, owner, he refused to pay him more money. So Louie said, well, let's not work. I said, okay. He said, I got the…
